summary: Phase 5 partial verification (spec #21 checkpoints + #26 chart tooltips). Tested frontend only via Playwright at 390x844. All 9 numbered checks PASSED. Login → Legacy → BUILD 3yr shows label strip 'Now 1YR 2YR 3YR'. Tap-to-tooltip works reliably on desktop web via PanResponder (mouse click bridged to touch events); left/middle/right taps produce 'TODAY · ACTUAL', 'YEARS FROM NOW · PROJECTED' variants, dollar amount, and subtitle 'BUILD · investments held flat'. 20yr GROW shows 5-year cadence 'Now 5YR 10YR 15YR 20YR' and tooltip renders 'YEAR 10 · PROJECTED' with 'GROW · 7% compound' subtitle. Retirement shows terminal label 'RETIRE'. Wealth NetWorth chart renders with 3 synthetic points and tolerates taps (no crash). Home teaser chart still renders. Regression sweep (Home/Budget/Reports/Activity/Wealth/Legacy) — zero JS console errors, only pre-existing deprecation warnings ('shadow*' props, one new 'props.pointerEvents' from the new tooltip View).

ui_bugs.issue: For the terminal RETIRE checkpoint, tooltip label reads 'YEAR {n} · PROJECTED' (e.g. 'YEAR 35 · PROJECTED') because meta.fullLabel is hard-coded to `Year ${y}` in index.tsx:3716. Spec #26 asked for 'RETIRE · PROJECTED'. Label strip below chart correctly reads 'RETIRE', so the mismatch is only inside the floating tooltip.

New tooltip container uses `pointerEvents="none"` as a prop (ProjectionLineChart.tsx:174). React Native has deprecated this in favor of style.pointerEvents. Emits warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. No functional impact.

issues: Tooltip fullLabel does not honor the special RETIRE terminal label — cosmetic; underlying label strip already says RETIRE.

react_native_issues.issue: `pointerEvents` used as a prop instead of style.pointerEvents (deprecated in RN 0.74+). Move to style. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ProjectionLineChart.tsx:174

action_items: Tooltip label for the terminal RETIRE point: set `meta.fullLabel = 'Retire'` (or `'At retirement (year ${y})'`) when `isRetirement && i === checkpoints.length - 1` inside the points builder at index.tsx:3711-3719 so the floating tooltip reads 'RETIRE · PROJECTED' instead of 'YEAR 35 · PROJECTED'.
Migrate `pointerEvents="none"` on the tooltip View to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` in ProjectionLineChart.tsx (line 174) to silence deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: PanResponder correctly translates locationX → nearest point using rendered width from onLayout — good defense against non-square viewports. Verified interactively works on web via mouse-click bridge.

activeIdx is not cleared when the parent switches timeframe (e.g. 20yr → Retirement). Old index can remain highlighted until the user taps again. Consider resetting activeIdx on `points` reference change (useEffect on points).
Tooltip is `pointerEvents=none` and top-positioned (top:-6). Verified this doesn't block re-taps on Legacy 3yr/20yr/Retirement charts.
